name: Trollbane
summary: At Hammerfall, the Darkspear prepare for battles against Zul'Gurub's jungle trolls. Vol'jin has sent them to recover Trol'kalar from ruined Stromgarde, where the blade rested in human hands.

sections.title: A King Fallen, A Blade Coveted
sections.body: After King Thoras Trollbane fell, Stromgarde became a ruin. Chieftain Vol'jin then ordered the Darkspear to spirit Trol'kalar away. The storied sword had long rested in human hands. Now the tribe seeks it for the battles ahead against Zul'Gurub's jungle trolls.

sections.title: Journey to Hammerfall
sections.body: Vol'jin sent Zengu, a seasoned hunter, to Hammerfall in the northeastern Arathi Highlands. From Stranglethorn Vale, Nimboya directs travelers to find Zengu and help secure the legendary sword.

faq.q: Why does Vol'jin want the sword Trol'kalar?
faq.answer: Vol'jin wants Trol'kalar for the coming battles against Zul'Gurub's hostile jungle trolls.
Zengu is a seasoned Darkspear hunter sent to Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands to oversee the recovery of Trol'kalar.

faq.q: Where does this journey send you?
faq.answer: You travel north from Stranglethorn Vale to Hammerfall, an outpost in the northeastern Arathi Highlands.
Stromgarde lies in ruins after its ruler, King Thoras Trollbane, fell.

angles.text: As a troll, you know Vol'jin seeks Trol'kalar to arm the Darkspear against their ancient kin in Zul'Gurub.
As a member of the Horde, you can find Zengu at Hammerfall, where he awaits the recovery of the legendary sword from human hands.
